SELECT m.code, m.name, m.spec, COALESCE(m.stock_qty, 0) AS stock_qty, m.safety_stock, m.base_order_qty, (SELECT wh.warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_cd = m.warehouse_cd LIMIT 1) AS warehouse, m.sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm, m.unit, (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'UNIT' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = unit LIMIT 1) AS unit_nm, m.unit_price, CASE
WHEN replace(COALESCE(m.client_code, ''), ' ', '') ~ '^([0-9]+|[[]("[0-9]+"(,"[0-9]+")*)?[]])$' THEN ( SELECT array_agg(c.name) FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = CASE WHEN replace(m.client_code, ' ', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN replace(m.client_code, ' ', '') ELSE m.client_code::jsonb ->> 0 END AND c.name IS NOT NULL AND c.name != '' ) WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(m.client_code, '')) != '' THEN ARRAY[TRIM(m.client_code)] ELSE NULL END AS suppliers FROM materials m ORDER BY m.name
SELECT material_code AS "code", order_date AS "d", SUM(qty) AS "qty" FROM material_purchase_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY material_code, order_date

SELECT u.material_code AS "code", s.schedule_date AS "d", SUM(u.qty_used) AS "qty" FROM production_material_usage u JOIN production_schedule s ON u.schedule_id = s.id WHERE s.schedule_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY u.material_code, s.schedule_date
SELECT material_code AS "code", receive_date AS "d", SUM(qty) AS "qty" FROM material_receiving WHERE receive_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY material_code, receive_date

SELECT material_code AS "code", SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) AS "d", SUM(COALESCE(in_qty, 0)) AS "inQty", SUM(COALESCE(out_qty, 0)) AS "outQty" FROM material_stock_movement WHERE SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY material_code, SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10)

SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(COALESCE(new_stock_qty, 0) - COALESCE(old_stock_qty, 0)) AS "qty", string_agg(DISTINCT note, ',') AS "notes" FROM material_stock_schedule WHERE applied = 1 AND effective_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY material_code
